text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate observed for tenant 'thornton-fin' on private VPC (dedicated pool: dp-12). NLB healthchecks failing, backend connections dropping. Paging sre-olivia and net-max.

sre-olivia: ack — looking. first thought: circuit-breaker on NLB or security group rate limit? any customer-facing errors? cs-amy can you confirm impact?

cs-amy: customer POC (Thornton) reports API timeouts for 2 availability zones ~2 minutes ago. They're seeing 502s & connection resets. They can reproduce via curl to their App LB URL.

net-max: brief triage: NLB (nlb-dp-12-frontend) shows flapping targets, healthchecks alternating healthy/unhealthy. Cloud logs show many TCP RST and connection limit reached on downstream instances. Possible SYN flood or misconfigured keepalive. Pulling NLB metrics.

platform-raj: adding logs from our side — forwarding relevant errors to the thread. past hour saw normal traffic then a sharp spike in new connections for tenant thornton.

sre-olivia: can we confirm if this is tenant isolation or noise from other tenants? dp-12 is dedicated but shares edge NLB with other customers.

ops-jordan: quick check — conntrack table on tenant boxes is near exhaustion on two hosts (host-11, host-12). counts ~126k entries, threshold 128k. That would explain new connections being dropped.

net-max: that matches. Looks like ephemeral port exhaustion / conntrack hit -> targets failing healthchecks -> NLB marks unhealthy -> clients see 502. Is traffic legitimate? cs-amy what patterns from customer?

cs-amy: customer says approx 20k concurrent clients, they had a spike from batch jobs ~05:10 UTC. They weren't expecting that many. They asked us to throttle/shape if possible.

sre-olivia: mitigation options (short):
- increase conntrack/timeouts and ephemeral port range on host-11/12 (fast but risk).
- NLB-level fallback: shift traffic weights away from dp-12 to a warm standby pool (dp-09) while hosts recover.
- Per-tenant rate-limit on edge (preferred for isolation) if we can apply quickly.

net-max: can do immediate weighted routing change in Route53 ALIAS weighted policy? We have global traffic manager that can failover to dp-09. Will that preserve tenant isolation? dp-09 has capacity for burst but needs config to accept thornton tenant.

platform-raj: dp-09 currently has the tenant disabled on its pool config for data-plane. Quick reconfigure needed; ops-jordan can enable tenant mapping and we can set a canary weight 10% then ramp.

ops-jordan: enabling mapping now (running script). Command:

```
./adminctl map-tenant --pool dp-09 --tenant thornton --mode temp
```

ops-jordan: mapping done. healthchecks still failing on dp-12 but dp-09 targets are healthy.

net-max: initiating weighted shift. Will start 10% to dp-09 -> monitor 1m -> then 50% -> 100% if stable. Applying now.

incident-bot: ACTION: reroute start applied by net-max at 2167894350

sre-olivia: monitoring latency & 5xx. P95 latency down slightly, 502 rate reduced by ~70% after 10% shift.

cs-amy: customer confirmed partial recovery on their side. still some errors in AZ-A but much improved for AZ-B.

net-max: ramping to 50% at 2167894402

sre-olivia: conntrack on host-11/12 dropping slowly as new connections decline. We'll also add a short-term conntrack tuning to give breathing room while we complete failover.

ops-jordan: applying temporary conntrack bump:

```
echo 262144 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=300
```

ops-jordan: conntrack increased. watch CPU on hosts.

platform-raj: once at 100% on dp-09, we should leave dp-12 isolated for deeper investigation and patch the keepalive behavior. Might need kernel update on hosts if conntrack leak.

net-max: ramped to 100% at 2167894455. dp-09 handling full traffic, 5xx nearly zero now. Leaving dp-12 drained.

sre-olivia: moving to post-incident tasks: 1) root cause: tenant burst + conntrack exhaustion on dp-12 hosts 2) mitigation applied: weighted failover to dp-09 + conntrack bump 3) customer impact: ~18 minutes degraded (05:10–05:28 UTC), intermittent 502s for ~10–15% of requests, now resolved.

cs-amy: I informed Thornton POC (poc-thornton) and provided timeline and next steps. They want a postmortem and a suggestion for traffic shaping.

poc-thornton: thanks team. their batch system will be patched. please include recommendations for connection reuse and token bucket on our side.

platform-raj: follow-ups: schedule kernel/conntrack analysis on host-11/12, add automated per-tenant rate limiting feature to prevent pool-wide conntrack exhaustion, add runbook for fast pool failover.

sre-olivia: handing to net-max for deeper network/root-cause debug and to platform-raj for infra fixes. If anything regresses, page SRE.

net-max: acknowledged. I'll run pcap + conntrack dump and open a ticket with infra team. tagging this incident for postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: marked resolved (user-impact mitigated) at 2167894467 — follow-ups assigned: INFRA-2198, PM-4452, SRE-ops review.

sre-olivia: thanks everyone. closing on-call handoff in 10m unless new alerts.

:thumbsup:
